Attachments: I’m attaching a short SOC2 summary and a pilot pricing template so you can see the inputs we use.

Thanks — happy to jump on another quick call if that’s easier.

- Throughput: supports baseline 100k tokens/day, no sustained burst guarantees.
- Support: email + weekly check-ins.
- Cache: minimal (prefix-only).

Option B (Recommended) — $26,000 flat for 6 weeks

- Cache + KV: enabled for latency and cost smoothing.
